description:
1. Installation of air conditioning system
Installation of a domestic multi-split air conditioning system to serve bedrooms. This includes the installation of one external air-source heat pump condenser unit mounted on the side elevation of the property within the side passage, positioned toward the rear of the house. The external unit will not be located on the principal (front) elevation and will not be visible from the public highway.

Associated internal works include installation of wall-mounted indoor units and concealed refrigerant pipework routed internally/within the side passage. The external unit will be mounted on wall brackets with appropriate vibration isolation and acoustic consideration.

2. Replacement of existing front boundary wall

Demolition and removal of the existing painted white rendered front boundary wall. Construction of a new brick boundary wall in its place, matching the character and appearance of the property and surrounding Conservation Area.

The new wall will follow the existing footprint and alignment, with height consistent with neighbouring boundary treatments. A brick coping/top detail will be provided to match traditional detailing in the street.

3. Replacement of existing front forecourt surface

Removal of the existing concrete hardstanding within the front forecourt. Installation of new paving/tiles to create a replacement hard surface of similar footprint. Materials to be appropriate in appearance and sympathetic to the character of the property and surrounding area.

Design Principles & Conservation Area Considerations

All the above works have been designed to ensure minimal visual intrusion, compliance with the Bedford Park Conservation Area policy, and respect for the original architectural character of the estate.
• External plant is sited out of view from the public highway and street frontage.
• New boundary treatments use traditional materials and align with neighbouring features.
• Surfaces and finishes have been selected to harmonise with the historic environment.
